conditions_applied: Caution order must be issued on NGP-WR-041 (adjacent section) from 01:15 to 04:30 UTC
Power block (OHE off) enforced from 01:30 to 04:15 UTC
Loco pilot of 12269 Duronto notified via COA caution advisory

xai_audit_log.decision_summary: Shadow Block SB-CR-20240815-007 APPROVED — M_j_effective (87.73) exceeds total penalty (58.73); block scheduled in low-traffic window 01:30–04:15 UTC with 3 departments co-synced. Net MILP benefit: +29.0 units.
xai_audit_log.narrative:
The MILP optimizer evaluated Shadow Block SB-CR-20240815-007 as a candidate covering section NGP-WR-042 (Nagpur–Selu, 882/4–898/7 km) for the window 01:30–04:15 UTC on 2024-08-15. This Shadow Block merges three engineering requests: Track (ballast tamping), OHE (mast inspection), and S&T (track circuit certification), achieving a 3-department synchronized block of 165 minutes against the alternative of 3 separate blocks totalling 630 minutes.

The maintenance yield M_j was assessed at 72.5 with an urgency multiplier of 1.21 (the section is approaching end-of-maintenance-cycle at only 3 months residual life without intervention), yielding M_j_effective = 87.73. The chosen time window (01:30–04:15 UTC) falls in the daily traffic trough on the CR Nagpur Division, with only 6 trains in the affected section during this period.

Of the 6 trains affected, only 58114 Gondia Passenger breaches its Δd_i threshold of 30 minutes (estimated delay: 35 minutes), contributing a financial SLA penalty of ₹1,68,000. The high-priority 12269 Duronto Express (P_i = 8.7) is estimated to accumulate only 12 minutes of additional delay — well within its effective remaining budget of 7 minutes above schedule — and has been proactively notified via the COA caution advisory system.

The total penalty cost λ·Σ(P_i·Δd_i) = 1.5 × 39.15 = 58.73, which is significantly below M_j_effective (87.73), resulting in a net positive MILP objective contribution of +29.0 units. The optimizer's LP relaxation assigned x_j = 0.94, indicating strong confidence in the approval decision. The sensitivity analysis shows that M_j would need to drop by 12.8 units before the decision would flip to rejection.

feature_importances.explanation: High track quality index gain (29.4) and safety risk reduction (22.8) drive the primary benefit. Urgency multiplier of 1.21 applied due to 3-month residual asset life.
FOIS traffic analysis shows only 6 trains in section during the requested window, compared to 18 trains during peak hours. This minimises the penalty term significantly.
Merging 3 departments into one 165-minute block saves 840 train-minutes versus sequential individual blocks, contributing a large operational efficiency gain.
Duronto's high P_i makes its delay costly. However, estimated delay (12 min) is within remaining budget, limiting its penalty contribution. This was the most constraining factor.
Only train to breach Δd_i; financial penalty ₹1,68,000 incurred. Low P_i (1.8) means limited overall impact on decision.

counterfactuals.scenario_label: If block shifted 2 hours later (03:30–06:15 UTC)
counterfactuals.reason_not_chosen: Three additional Superfast express trains (P_i avg 6.1) enter the section after 03:30, increasing penalty cost by 14.2 units and causing 2 additional SLA breaches.

Skipping the block allows section to operate beyond residual maintenance life (3 months), creating an elevated risk of track geometry defect. M_j_effective is forfeited entirely. Safety constraint violation flagged.

counterfactuals.scenario_label: If only Track block approved (OHE/S&T excluded)
counterfactuals.reason_not_chosen: Partial merge would require two additional separate blocks for OHE and S&T within the next 72 hours, consuming 420 additional train-minutes. Shadow Block merge is 31.5 units more efficient.

key_trains_cited: 12269 Duronto Express (P_i=8.7, remaining budget=7min, estimated delay=12min — within threshold)
58114 Gondia Passenger (P_i=1.8, Δd_i=30min, estimated delay=35min — SLA BREACH, ₹1,68,000 penalty)
xai_audit_log.compliance_statement: This decision complies with Indian Railway Block Rules 2022 (Rule 9.3: Shadow Block approval authority vested in AI scheduler with DRM concurrence), CRIS BDMS operational guidelines v3.1, and Safety Circular SC-2024-047 (minimum block window for tamping operations). Power block authorization obtained per OHE Maintenance Manual Chapter 14. Caution order dispatch procedure follows GR-SR 3.68.
